title: Data Annotation Quality Validation Tool
description: A Python tool that validates the quality of COCO-style image object-detection annotations, simulating a real annotation-review pipeline. Automatically flags out-of-bounds and degenerate boxes, missing labels, and duplicate/overlapping boxes (via IoU), plus class-imbalance checks — outputting a CSV report ready for human review.

title: Cache Controller FSM Simulator
description: A C++ finite-state-machine simulator for a direct-mapped cache controller based on Patterson & Hennessy, modeling write-back and write-allocate policies. Walks through cycle-by-cycle transitions across IDLE, COMPARE_TAG, WRITE_BACK, and ALLOCATE for read/write hits and dirty misses.

title: Book Recommendation System
description: A C++ book recommendation system built on object-oriented principles with a file-based data store. Recommends titles by genre and rating while demonstrating encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and file handling. Built as a team project ("The Semi-Colons").
